map.管理学习科目，设置目标进度，追踪完成情况: Manage your subjects, set target progress and follow it through
map.根据科目难度自动分配每周学习时间: Allocates each week's study time automatically according to subject difficulty
map.查看每日/每周/累计学习时长和任务完成情况: See daily, weekly and cumulative study time plus task completion
map.内置迷你番茄钟，帮助专注学习: A built-in mini Pomodoro helps you stay focused
map.番茄钟累计专注 = 单次专注分钟数 × 完成轮数；任务完成率 = 已完成任务数: Cumulative Pomodoro focus = minutes per session × rounds; completion rate = tasks done ÷ total tasks × 100%; pending planned minutes = sum of minutes for unfinished tasks. Tasks are listed high → medium → low priority.
map.分钟数需为正整数: Minutes must be a positive integer
map.📚 深度解析：按科目难度²分配每日/每周学习时长，并用优先级与完成率管理任务节奏: 📚 In-depth: allocate daily/weekly study time by squared subject difficulty, and manage task rhythm with priority and completion rate.
map.备考分配：把每日总时长按科目难度²加权拆分，难科目自动拿到更多时间。: Exam prep allocation: split daily study time by squared difficulty so harder subjects get more time.
map.今日任务：任务带高/中/低优先级，列表按高→中→低排序，勾选完成后自动累计科目时: Today's tasks: tasks carry high/medium/low priority, are listed high → medium → low, and ticking one adds its minutes to the subject total.
map.进度复盘：完成率 = 已完成任务 ÷ 任务总数，待办计划分钟提示剩余工作量。: Progress review: completion rate = done tasks ÷ total tasks; pending planned minutes show the remaining workload.
map.默认 4 门科目难度 5/4/4/3，权重为 25/16/16/9，总权重 66: Default 4 subjects with difficulty 5/4/4/3 give weights 25/16/16/9 and total 66. With 6 hours/day and 6 days/week: Math = 25/66×6 ≈ 2.27h → 136 min (2h16m); English and Physics = 16/66×6 ≈ 1.45h → 87 min (1h27m); Chinese = 9/66×6 ≈ 0.82h → 49 min; weekly total 36.0h. With 1 of 4 default tasks done → completion rate 25%, pending planned minutes 60+45+40 = 145.
map.权重取难度平方：1–5 星对应权重 1–25，难度 5 的科目拿 25 份，难度: Weight is the square of difficulty: 1–5 stars map to weights 1–25, so a 5-star subject gets 25 shares while a 3-star gets only 9 — harder subjects get noticeably more time.
map.完成率怎么算？: How is the completion rate calculated?
map.已完成任务数 ÷ 当前任务总数 × 100%；任务列表为空时显示「—」，避免除零: Done tasks ÷ current total tasks × 100%; it shows “—” when the list is empty to avoid division by zero.
map.任务、科目与统计仅保存在本机浏览器 localStorage，清理缓存或更换设备: Tasks, subjects and statistics live only in this browser's localStorage; clearing the cache or switching devices does not sync them, so export important plans as backups.
map.科目权重 = 难度²，总权重 = Σ 难度²；每日时间 = 该科权重 ÷ 总权重: Subject weight = difficulty², total weight = Σ difficulty²; daily time = subject weight ÷ total weight × daily total time, weekly time = daily time × study days per week, share = weight ÷ total weight × 100%; total weekly study time = daily duration × study days. Subject time share = subject cumulative minutes ÷ all minutes × 100%, hours = minutes ÷ 60 (one decimal)
